increment: doc72 section 20.36, named retained-manifest refusal and explicit recovery without reexecution

recovery_scenario.basis: Each case creates a real CPU SGD source and a measured seven-execution passing gate, then damages only its retained proposal manifest.
clients: HTTP through typed MCP transport bridge
Assistant UpstreamTools with explicit approval fixture
recovery_scenario.refusal: New check/advance names the run-relative manifest and exposes neither parser output nor corrupted source text. No claim, execution, advance or resume is appended.
recovery_scenario.exact_receipts: Typed MCP proposal/check ACK recovery returns the original receipt while the manifest is damaged and events remain complete; no training repeats.
recovery_scenario.restoration: Restoring original bytes leaves event bytes unchanged. An explicitly submitted advance then uses the original still-current gate; execution count stays 7.

coverage: Focused native Windows private CPU, engine/API/MCP/Assistant-tool and documentation checks. Not a whole UI chat/resume acceptance, full CI or owner-repository delivery.
remaining_open: Original request recovery when the client is lost before manifest publication
